name: fix-done-closure-post-done-freshness
title: Fix post-DONE evidence freshness projection
description: Fix Lattice DONE oracle behavior where done_closure for already DONE stories compares historical test evidence against current main HEAD/materialHash, causing post-DONE unrelated material commits to appear as evidence-freshness failures. DONE stories should project freshness against the recorded evidence snapshot while active TEST/DONE entry gates still compare against current workspace state.
